matches.description: Watch Benfica vs SC Braga highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 11, 2026. The Estádio da Luz played host to a tactical battle that exploded into life on 2026-05-11, as Benfica and SC Braga met in a highly anticipated Primeira Liga encounter. Fans were treated to a spectacle defined by narrow margins and constant intervention from the video assistant referee. A Tense Opening Under VAR Scrutiny The match began with immediate tension as both sides searched for an early breakthrough. Just four minutes in, Franjo Ivanovic thought he had given Benfica the lead, but a VAR review ruled the goal out for offside. The first half continued to be a cagey affair, with both teams struggling to find a clear chance in the final third. On the stroke of halftime, another VAR check for a potential Benfica penalty kept the supporters on the edge of their seats, but the referee eventually decided against awarding the spot-kick after reviewing the footage. Second Half Explosion The second half ignited instantly, delivering the clinical finishing that was missing before the break. Only a minute after the restart, Rafa Silva pounced on a loose ball to fire Benfica ahead with a sharp right-footed finish. However, the celebrations were short-lived. In the 48th minute, Victor Gomez delivered a precise cross that allowed Pau Víctor to head home the equalizer for SC Braga , completely resetting the dynamic of the game and shifting the momentum back to the visitors. Late Drama and Penalty Redemption The drama intensified as the clock ticked down towards the final whistle. Benfica thought they had regained the lead in the 66th minute, but VAR intervened for a third time, revoking the goal because the ball had gone out of play in the build-up. As the home side pushed forward, Braga struck on the counter. In the 88th minute, Mario Dorgeles set up Jean-Baptiste Gorby , who unleashed a powerful strike from outside the box to silence the home crowd. With the game entering stoppage time, the referee awarded a penalty for a foul by Carvalho on Andreas Schjelderup . Vangelis Pavlidis stepped up in the 95th minute and calmly converted to rescue a point in an unforgettable afternoon of sports entertainment.

matches.description: Watch Estoril Praia vs Benfica highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 16, 2026. The Estádio António Coimbra da Mota set the stage for a high-stakes encounter in the Primeira Liga as Estoril Praia welcomed the giants from Lisbon. On this 16th of May, 2026, both sides looked to make a statement in a match defined by tactical shifts and clinical finishing. A Stormy Start in Estoril The match began with an overwhelming display of offensive efficiency from Benfica . Just seven minutes in, Richard Rios found himself in the perfect position to tap the ball into an open net, silencing the home crowd. The pressure didn't stop there; in a frantic two-minute window, the Eagles effectively took control of the contest. First, Alexander Bah capitalized on a delivery from Gianluca Prestianni and Tomas Araujo to score in the 15th minute. Seconds later, before Estoril Praia could even catch their breath, Rafa Silva struck a left-footed shot into the back of the net, assisted again by the influential Prestianni . Tactical Battles and Defensive Resilience As the game progressed into the second half, the rhythm became more disjointed as the referee's notebook began to fill up. Gonçalo Costa and Andre Lacximicant were cautioned for the hosts, while Alexander Bah and Gianluca Prestianni saw yellow for the visitors. Despite the comfortable lead, Benfica continued to search for more, with Richard Rios nearly grabbing a second in the 86th minute, only to see his effort heroically hacked off the goal line by Kevin Boma . Tactical substitutions from both benches, including the introduction of Bruma and Rafik Guitane , attempted to shift the momentum, but the defensive lines largely held firm through the middle period of the half. Late Drama and the Final Whistle In the dying moments of the match, Estoril Praia finally found a breakthrough to reward their persistence. In the first minute of stoppage time, Peixinho unleashed a spectacular left-footed strike from outside the box that beat the keeper, following a setup by Kevin Boma . While the goal brought a surge of energy to the stands, it proved to be a mere consolation. Leandro Barreiro had one final chance for Benfica shortly after, but his shot flew wide. The final whistle confirmed a professional performance from the Lisbon side, who managed the closing stages with 52% possession to secure the points.

matches.description: Watch FC St. Gallen vs Benfica highlights and goals from UEFA Europa League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 23, 2026. FC St. Gallen and Benfica clashed in a high-stakes UEFA Europa League encounter that showcased the tactical depth and competitive spirit of both sides. As the match kicked off on July 23, 2026 , the atmosphere was electric, with both teams looking to establish an early foothold in this prestigious competition. First Half: Tactical Battle Leads to Goals The opening stages were a cagey affair as both sides felt each other out. The physical nature of the game became apparent when Lukas Goertler received a yellow card in the 30th minute. However, Goertler quickly turned from villain to hero, providing a precise assist in the 37th minute for Aliou Balde , who finished clinicaly to put St. Gallen ahead. Benfica refused to be rattled and began to find their rhythm as the interval approached. Their persistence paid off in the 44th minute when Vangelis Pavlidis linked up beautifully with Rafa Silva . The experienced forward made no mistake, leveling the score and ensuring the teams went into the halftime break on equal terms after a pulsating first 45 minutes. Second Half: Gaal Delivers the Decisive Blow The intensity remained high after the restart, with the referee busy as Jozo Stanic and Vangelis Pavlidis both entered the book. Both managers turned to their benches to find a spark, with Benfica introducing Tiago Gouveia and Enzo Barrenechea , while the hosts brought on fresh legs in the form of Andrin Hunziker and Diego Besio . The breakthrough finally arrived in the 80th minute. Lukas Daschner turned provider, setting up Tom Gaal , who struck a powerful shot into the net to restore the lead for St. Gallen . Despite a late scare and a yellow card for Gaal in stoppage time, the home side managed the closing minutes expertly to secure a hard-fought victory against the Portuguese giants.
